Explicit edge pixels articulate wheel/spokes. Front/rear native views inspected after modest panel brightening; shared casing and isolated gauge retained.

Rear native view inspected.

Worst octagon sweep clears bed by over 1.8 model units; wheel's X interval stays outside bearing housing. Shaft contact intentional. Native animation export/reopen checked.
